name: Dmytro Matviiv
description: Dmytro Matviiv is the CEO of HackenProof, expert bug bounty and crowdsourced audit platform working with crypto leaders such as Ethereum Foundation, MetaMask, Polygon, OKX, SUI and more. ETHSecurity Expert Badge holder with 15 years in data encryption, authentication and developing cybersecurity products. Specializes in evidence validation, threat attribution, and collaborative intelligence. Nowadays, HackenProof consists of a community of over 80K security researchers.
